messages:
maya: FYI: nightly synthetic load job (apples harness) alerted this morning — reproducible latency spike on big-seq workloads. attaching logs.
ci-bot: nightly-run 1918765432 FAILED: apples-to-apples check exceeded threshold (p95 +7%). https://ci.internal/runs/987
lucas: Noted. Is this kernel selector or batching heuristic? any kvcache warmup missing?
maya: Initial profiler points at increased per-token kernel time for seq > 1024. KV cache hit-rate looks normal after warmup but cold-start penalty higher.
anika: Can you paste the exact harness config used? seed/sampler change often causes flakiness.
maya: ```
apples_harness --model redwood-7B --seq 2048 --sampler uniform --seed 42 --batch-policy 'latency-priority' --replay=true
```
We flipped sampler from stratified->uniform in infra PR #4121 last week.
dan: Where was the run executed? GPU family? kernel build hash?
maya: g5x2 shard, kernel hash: abc1234, runtime build: 2026-03-15-rc3. Replay used synthetic pacing (pseudo-real).
lucas: I suspect kernel-selector tie-breaker: when memory footprint crosses threshold it picks a slower kernel. I can repro locally with reduced input and try a fix.
maya: Repro steps: ./bench/apples_local.sh --seed 42 --seq 2048 --iter 20. Flamegraph: https://artifacts.internal/fg/1918765432.svg
dan: Let's avoid noisy nightly alerts until triage. Proposal: mute alert for 24h, create canary job that runs apples with frozen sampler+seed+kernelhash so apples are apples.
ci-bot: Alert muted by @dan. Canary scheduled: apples-canary-1918765432. https://ci.internal/runs/988
anika: Also please publish per-run metadata (kernel hash, sampler, seed, machine) to the benchmark dashboard so diffs are deterministic.
lucas: Patch landed in PR #4178: selector now prefers kernel with lower per-token time when mem diff small. Running CI apples again.
ci-bot: apples-canary 1918765490 PASSED: p95 delta -0.2%. https://ci.internal/runs/989
maya: Great. Next steps: freeze sampling config in CI (seed + stratified), add deterministic KV warmup (pre-populate prefixes), and change regression gate to require >5% p95 across 3 consecutive runs before firing. I'll open follow-ups.
lucas: will follow up with perf microbench to validate kernel selection heuristics across seq buckets.
maya: :thumbsup:
